name: reportinstance_auth
label: Report Instance Authorization Table
description: Instance authorization table for report instances this table is used for related queries related to report instances, such as report queries.

fields.name: reportinstance_id
fields.description: Report instance ID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: type
fields.description: user: user; role: role; team: group. Used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: auth_uuid
fields.description: UUID, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the reportinstance_id, type, auth_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: idx_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the auth_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
